# Version-Control Docs Checklist

- Inspect README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, release docs, CI workflows, version files, and PR templates.
- Preserve existing branch, commit, changelog, tag, and release conventions.
- Avoid hardcoded organization URLs and copied repo names.
- Use generic examples and placeholders.
- Summarize actual diff, not guessed scope.
- Include behavior, API, database, configuration, security, and compatibility impact.
- Include exact test commands and results only when known.
- Keep changelog entries user-facing.
- Include migration and rollback notes when relevant.
- Verify links or state skipped checks.
